time_handling.description: When comparing times in CSV data, ALWAYS convert to minutes or datetime objects
time_handling.warning: DO NOT compare time strings directly like '17:30' >= '17:28' - this gives wrong results!
time_handling.correct_approach: hour, minute = time_str.strip().split(':'); total_minutes = int(hour) * 60 + int(minute); Then compare: total_minutes >= 17*60+30 (for 17:30)

csv_handling.description: CSV files often have whitespace in column names and values
required_steps: df.columns = df.columns.str.strip()  # Remove whitespace from column names
df = df.apply(lambda x: x.str.strip() if x.dtype == 'object' else x)  # Strip string values

image.description: Extract text from images using OpenAI Vision API
image.script:
cat > read_image.py << 'EOF'
import base64
from openai import OpenAI
b64 = base64.b64encode(open('receipt.jpg','rb').read()).decode()
r = OpenAI().chat.completions.create(model='gpt-4o', messages=[{'role':'user','content':[{'type':'text','text':'Extract all text from this receipt'},{'type':'image_url','image_url':{'url':f'data:image/jpeg;base64,{b64}'}}]}])
print(r.choices[0].message.content)
EOF
python read_image.py

reimbursement_calculations.description: Rules for calculating reimbursable amounts from receipts
rules: The full subtotal amount IS reimbursable (no per-person limit applies)
Tips: max 20% of the subtotal is reimbursable
If actual tip exceeds 20%, only reimburse 20% of subtotal
